title: Runtime array length
blurb: The bounds guard every kernel over a runtime-sized storage array needs: `src.length` reads the bound buffer's length as WGSL `arrayLength(&src)`, a `u32`, so the guard is real where it once folded to `gid.x >= 0u` and returned every invocation (#46). `compile()` emits WGSL and no GLSL text for it: a runtime-sized `read_write` storage array is not supported yet by the GLSL backend (Rule 10.5), and the WebGL2 tier runs the compute entry as its pass program (Rule 11.8).
